content_sections.heading: IIITDM Kancheepuram Technician Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIITDM Kancheepuram Technician Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Technician.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Technician post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for this recruitment is the Walk-in date, which is 28 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Diploma or B.E./B.Tech. in relevant engineering fields with specified years of experience and a minimum percentage/CGPA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Technician post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years, with age relaxation applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Technician post?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 30,000 + 30% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Technician post?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test and an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held at Indian Institute of Information Technology Design and Manufacturing Kancheepuram, Tamil Nadu.
